# streamline_cluster (Data Source)

Retrieves information about the Streamline cluster.

This data source provides broker information and the controller node reported by Kafka.
The Kafka API used by this provider does not expose a cluster identifier, so no synthetic cluster ID is returned.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "streamline_cluster" "current" {}

output "controller_id" {
  value = data.streamline_cluster.current.controller_id
}

output "broker_count" {
  value = length(data.streamline_cluster.current.brokers)
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `brokers` (Attributes List) List of brokers in the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--brokers))
- `cluster_id` (String, Deprecated) Deprecated compatibility field. Always null because the Kafka API does not expose a stable cluster identity.
- `controller_id` (Number) The broker ID of the current controller.
- `id` (String, Deprecated) Deprecated compatibility field. Always null because the Kafka API does not expose a stable cluster identity.

<a id="nestedatt--brokers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `brokers`

Read-Only:

- `host` (String) The broker hostname.
- `id` (Number) The broker ID.
- `port` (Number) The broker port.
- `rack` (String) The rack ID of the broker (if configured).
